headline: 智利淘金紀錄片上映
context: 紀錄片《The Fabulous Gold Harvesting Machine》細膩記錄智利火地島（Tierra del Fuego）的老金礦工 Toto Gesell 的日常，評論說這部片本身就是一次影像採礦。同期，阿爾巴尼亞首都地拉那（Tirana）的 Bread & Heart 建築節正在梳理這個城市如何在幾年內成為歐洲建築實驗場；英國作家 Anna Goldreich 的首部小說《The Leveret》則書寫晚期流產後的療癒歷程。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Alfredo Pourailly De La Plaza’s absorbing documentary about an ageing Chilean gold panner is meticulously detailed and doubles as its own act of visual prospecting Out on the remote archipelago of Tierra del Fuego in Chile, Toto Gesell holds on to a profession that hails from bygone times: gold prospecting. Every day, come rain or shine, he puts on his rubber boots and heads to a local creek, where he searches for specks of gold the old-fashioned way: with a pan, a shovel and a homemade sluice. His daily routines are documented with great tenderness in Alfredo Pourailly De La Plaza’s absorbing documentary, shot over nearly a decade. The camera often lingers on Toto’s wrinkled hands, as he carefully handles tiny flecks of the precious metal, or writes down his hopes and dreams in a neatly kept diary. Despite his contentment with this simple way of life, his body is etched with the physical toil of the demanding work. When Jorge, Toto’s worried son, decides to build a trommel from scratch to help automate his father’s work, the film acquires the fervour of a monumental quest. This colossal undertaking ends up taking years; through riveting editing, the documentary oscillates between two competing timelines: one of the trommel’s gradual completion, and another of Toto’s declining health, as the juxtaposition accentuates the urgency of Jorge’s mission. When Toto suffers a serious health crisis while prospecting, the preciousness of time feels as tangible as the gold dust that slips through his fingers. Continue reading...

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Something has been happening in Tirana that the architectural world has not quite found the language for. In the space of a few years, a city of less than a million people in one of Europe's least-known countries has become the site of an extraordinary concentration of architectural ambition — a place where offices that rarely work in the same city, let alone the same decade, are building simultaneously, and where the questions that preoccupy contemporary architecture seem to arrive with an unusual urgency.
sources.title: Go East: What Tirana's Bread & Heart Festival Reveals About Architecture and Landscape

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This bold debut about a woman finding healing after a late miscarriage is written with utter conviction Birth. “A detaching, a loosening of something, then the pain of it.” A small, curled and crinkled creature is wrested from that pain. But then, instead of the long-awaited cry of a newborn: silence. This is the background of Anna Goldreich’s highly accomplished, calmly devastating first novel The Leveret, a book that asks us to see late miscarriage as the death it feels like for many mothers. Since this miscarriage, six months ago, Clare has felt everyone, including her partner Phoebe, impatiently expecting her to get on with her life. But she remains floored by loss, stuck waiting for that first cry. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Leveret By Anna Goldreich review – a hare mends the pain of baby loss

thread_text:
本週藝文有幾件事。

紀錄片《The Fabulous Gold Harvesting Machine》細膩跟拍智利火地島（Tierra del Fuego）的老金礦工 Toto Gesell，他每天穿著橡皮靴去河邊淘金，這個職業在當地幾乎是歷史。評論說這部片本身就是一次影像採礦，細緻而有重量。

阿爾巴尼亞首都地拉那（Tirana）正在舉辦 Bread & Heart 建築節，呈現這個城市如何在幾年內吸引了一批世界頂尖建築師同時在此蓋東西——這個現象目前建築界還找不到一套完整的語言來描述。

英國作家 Anna Goldreich 的首部小說《The Leveret》寫的是一位女性在晚期流產後走向療癒的故事，評論形容這部書「沉穩而令人心碎」。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 ArchDaily，2026 年 06 月 22 日，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
影評這邊有一部新紀錄片：《The Fabulous Gold Harvesting Machine》跟拍智利火地島（Tierra del Fuego）的老金礦工 Toto Gesell。他每天穿著橡皮靴去河邊淘金，一個在現代幾乎消失的職業。評論說這部片有它的詩意，細緻、沉穩。

建築面，阿爾巴尼亞首都地拉那（Tirana）正在舉辦 Bread & Heart 建築節，梳理這個城市近年成為歐洲建築實驗場的過程。建築界說目前還找不到一套語言來描述地拉那正在發生的事，而這個節是一次嘗試。

書的這邊，英國作家 Anna Goldreich 的首部小說《The Leveret》書寫晚期流產後的療癒歷程，評論稱其「沉穩而令人心碎」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 ArchDaily 於 2026 年 06 月 22 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 智利有部新紀錄片，跟拍火地島最後一位金礦工的日子。他叫 Toto Gesell，每天穿橡皮靴去河邊淘金，這個職業在當地幾乎已成歷史，評論說拍出了它的詩意。地拉那（Tirana）這幾年悄悄成了歐洲建築實驗場，目前有個建築節在梳理這個城市正在發生的事。書的這邊，Anna Goldreich 的處女作《The Leveret》寫流產後走向療癒，評論說它沉穩而令人心碎。
